svg.title: Where W_O fits in multi-head attention
svg.desc: A diagram showing the flow from input X through Q, K, V projections, per-head attention computation, concatenation, and finally the W_O output projection that mixes information across heads.

g.text: dims 0-63 = head 0, dims 64-127 = head 1, ... dims 448-511 = head 7
512 x 512 learned matrix — mixes the heads

svg.text: Before W_O: each output dim sees only 1 head.
After W_O: each output dim is a learned mix of all 8 heads.
